skill.description: 当用户给出小红书关键词、赛道、人群或产品方向，想看热门高互动笔记样本，并拆解标题结构、内容角度、互动信号、创作灵感和选题参考时使用。
skill.summary: Research Xiaohongshu note samples and identify title hooks, engagement signals, and reusable topic ideas.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Forty static alerts are false positives involving Markdown, legitimate API setup, official service links, and readable Chinese text. One command finding confirms unpinned npm package execution with access to the API credential environment. A semantic finding identifies mandatory sharing of token-bearing URLs without a redaction boundary; no evidence of deliberate exfiltration was found.

remediation.issue: The quick-start command automatically executes socialdatax-skills@latest in the credential-bearing environment.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify its provenance, and obtain execution consent before supplying a narrowly scoped API key.

remediation.issue: The output instructions require xsec_token retention even in stored or forwarded URLs and explicitly prohibit redaction.
remediation.suggestion: Keep complete URLs only in authorized private workflows; allow token redaction and require consent before sharing token-bearing links.

content.user_title: Research Xiaohongshu Notes and Content Angles
content.value_statement: Finding useful Xiaohongshu examples requires more than sorting posts by popularity. This skill guides keyword searches and turns returned samples into title, engagement, and topic insights.
actual_capabilities: Guides keyword-based note searches through the SocialDataX CLI or the xhs_search_notes MCP tool.
Documents sorting by likes, comments, collections, recency, or general relevance.
Supports content-type and publication-time filters, with additional recent-days filtering through the CLI.
Organizes returned titles, authors, engagement metrics, publication times, links, and note identifiers into a sample report.
Analyzes title hooks, content angles, interaction signals, and reusable topic ideas from available samples.
Explains cursor pagination and partial-result recovery while retaining the original page and item limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and an available external CLI or configured MCP tool; API credits may be required.
The package contains instructions and agent metadata, not the external CLI implementation.
Results reflect the selected keywords and retrieved pages, not complete platform coverage or guaranteed audience performance.
Does not promise finished posts, cover designs, account diagnosis, publishing, or account interactions.

use_cases.title: Find Topic Ideas
use_cases.description: Review relevant note samples and identify reusable hooks before choosing the next topic.

use_cases.title: Compare Product Content Angles
use_cases.description: Compare sampled engagement signals and messaging angles for a product category without treating popularity as proof of sales.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Sample-Based Research Brief
use_cases.description: Document authors, publication times, available metrics, and sampling boundaries for an editorial research brief.

prompt_templates.title: Explore One Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Research Xiaohongshu notes about [topic]. Use one page and at most five samples. Summarize titles, available engagement signals, and three topic ideas.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: run a small initial search.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Relevant Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [keyword] for [audience]. Search image notes from the past week, ordered by likes. Return at most 20 samples and explain recurring title hooks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: apply audience context and search filters.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Content Angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [keyword A] and [keyword B] with identical filters and ten samples each. Separate observed metrics from interpretations. Identify reusable angles and coverage limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare two bounded sample sets.

prompt_templates.title: Recover a Partial Research Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue this partial search using its returned cursor and unchanged filters. Deduct completed pages and items from the original limits. Report retained results and unresolved errors.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover an interrupted run without restarting the first page.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: research beginner indoor gardening notes using one page and five samples.
output: Sample report: list returned titles, authors, publication times, available metrics, and source references.
Hook analysis: group observed titles by question, checklist, or comparison structure.
Topic ideas: suggest angles supported by the retrieved samples, not a platform-wide ranking.
Evidence boundary: mark missing fields and state the retrieved page and item counts.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: continue a partial search after its API error has been resolved.
output: Status: retain previously returned samples and state that the earlier run was incomplete.
Recovery: continue only when a nonempty continuation cursor is available.
Budget: subtract completed pages and collected items from the original limits.
Stopping condition: stop at either limit and report any remaining uncertainty.

best_practices: Start with a focused keyword and a small sample budget before expanding the search.
Review and pin the external CLI package before executing it with a scoped API key.
Keep token-bearing source links private and confirm sharing permissions before distributing research reports.
anti_patterns: Treating a small returned sample as complete platform coverage or a guarantee of future traffic.
Restarting a partial search from the first page without accounting for collected items and API costs.
Copying API keys or token-bearing links into public prompts, logs, or shared reports.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword or topic direction. Audience, product, and content-format context can help narrow the research.

faq.question: What must be configured before a search?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and either the external CLI runtime or the corresponding MCP tool. The provider may require available API credits.

faq.question: Does it publish or interact with my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only. It does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify account settings.

faq.question: Does it identify every popular note?
faq.answer: No. Findings are limited to the chosen keywords, filters, retrieved pages, and available fields.

faq.question: What happens when a search returns partial results?
faq.answer: Retain available samples and errors. Continue with the returned cursor and remaining limits instead of automatically restarting the search.

faq.question: Can I share the report without reviewing its links?
faq.answer: No. The source instructions preserve xsec_token in links. Review recipient permissions and remove sensitive URL parameters before public distribution.
